comparison.objective: Shelve returned books upright and brace them with a bookend; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated placement, gap/tilt control and final bracing versus recessed fastener work, fine rotation and iterative dynamic tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Books form an upright closed row with at most 5 mm gaps and 5-degree tilt, then are braced versus two safe repeatable stops.
comparison.reason: Stable arrangement of passive objects does not test adjustable damping behavior.
